title: Maze House
content: Mine is a large-ish house and I have to correctly complete an obstacle course like maze. That's the only way to describe it. Most of the house is under construction/being renovated so I find myself having to climb scaffolding and go between plastic sheeting then there are small tunnel like spaces and ladders. Im trying to reach the attic where i live and will be safe. I will only be able to reach it, however if I complete the tasks in the correct order.
